start: Owner of a real, online gym that has paid MettleUp; Settings → Pay MettleUp → 'Your receipts'

user_sees: Title 'Receipt' with the receipt number under it
MettleUp's business name on top, its legal name and address when the server has them, the word 'Receipt'
Lines 'Receipt number', 'Date', 'Gym' (name and gym code), 'Plan', 'Period', 'Amount paid' with paise, 'Paid by' with the reference
A tax line at the foot
must_not: An amount that differs from what the gym paid
A period that does not match the plan bought

user_sees: The browser's print box, showing only the receipt
must_not: The page header, the menu or the button printed on the paper
A dark background on the paper

start: Owner; a receipt address that is wrong, or opened where it cannot load

steps.action: Open /settings/mettleup/receipt/<a number that is not this gym's>
user_sees: 'Open it again from Settings, Pay MettleUp, Your receipts.'
must_not: No 'Print or save as PDF' button offered for nothing

steps.action: Open a real receipt while the internet is off or the server fails
user_sees: Today the same 'Receipt not found' words (see the finding)
must_not: The owner believing the receipt does not exist

steps.action: Open the address in the demo gym, or as front desk
user_sees: 'Receipt not found' (no receipt is asked for)
must_not: A real receipt shown to the desk or in the demo

start: Owner opened a receipt last month

steps.action: Open the same receipt again from 'Your receipts'
user_sees: The same number, date, amount and period as before
must_not: A receipt whose figures changed after it was issued

user_sees: The Pay MettleUp page with the list of receipts

steps.action: Use the browser's back button after printing

start: An owner with two gyms, or someone who guesses a receipt number

steps.action: Change the number in the address to another gym's receipt number
must_not: Any line of the other gym's receipt: name, amount or reference

steps.action: Print a receipt of the own gym
user_sees: The gym's name and code and what was paid; MettleUp's legal name only when the server holds one
must_not: A personal name or address typed into the app's own code
The owner's mobile number on the paper
